The Customer acknowledges and accepts that all drawings, technical specifications, software and documents supplied by Kimatic srl to the Customer for the execution of the project and/or the machinery are and remain the exclusive property of Kimatic srl, which shall also retain the industrial property rights thereto. The Customer also undertakes to refrain, whether directly or indirectly, from exploiting, assigning to third parties or making any use, even free of charge, of the aforesaid drawings, specifications, software and documents as well as of the information and know-how contained therein or connected therewith, except with the prior written consent of Kimatic srl. All information exchanged between the parties in connection with the project and the Contract shall be treated as confidential and shall not be published or disclosed to third parties. The Customer is required to keep confidential all technical information (e.g. drawings, technical brochures, software, documentation, formulas and correspondence in general) received from Kimatic srl and in any case learned in the performance of the Contract and directly or indirectly connected with the project or the machinery. Such industrial and intellectual property rights relating to the Products sold shall remain the exclusive property of Kimatic.
